{"action": "done", "why": "Under AMD-SUP-2026-02 (effective 1 September 2026 amending POL-SUP-003 §4.4), UN 38.3 certificates are accepted only if issued within the last 12 months (and valid for at least 60 days after the order placement date). A certificate issued 18 months ago no longer qualifies and counts as no certificate, so the order cannot be placed."}
